Name: Anime Abigail Chestnut Hair Portrait and Sprite - Fixed for Version 1.4
Author: Kurotaku
Description:
The original Mod from RaienVOLT doen't work correctly with the game update 1.4.x. I fixed it because the original creator isn't active anymore.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2575

﻿HOW TO INSTALL:
Content Patcher Version
- Extract the Folder in the Mods folder

Files for manual replacement
- For the character sprite, copy "Abigail.xnb" and paste it in StardewValley\Content\Characters
- For the portrait, copy "Abigail.xnb" and paste it in StardewValley\Content\Portraits
